transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I just can't seem to sit still. It's like... I don't know, like there's a motor humming under my skin or something. Whenever I have to sit for a while, like during staff meetings at work or... or those briefings before church events, I just end up shifting around a lot. Sometimes I just have to stand up or find an excuse to walk around. It's just... bothersome.
Did you have this kind of difficulty sitting still when you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. I remember getting in trouble for it back in grade school, actually. Just... popping out of my seat. Talking over the teacher, things like that. I guess I had a habit of rushing ahead before they even finished giving directions. My mother used to say I acted like I was... wound too tight. Even as a kid. So, yeah.
How much has this restlessness affected your work, home life, or relationships?

Well... mostly at work, I suppose. I've been getting some complaints lately. My supervisor has had to correct me a few times because... well, I guess I miss parts of the instructions when they're talking. And it causes some friction with the other guys when we're doing room turnovers or... figuring out the supplies. It actually got to the point where my boss pushed me toward the employee assistance program. So... that's where things are at.
Do you also find yourself feeling anxious or worried a lot of the time?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I'm an anxious person. Just... restless, like I said.
